description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) scores for different Large Language Models (LLMs) under varying conditions of Self-Fine-Tuning (SFT). The horizontal axis represents the LLM, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B”, “LLaMA-2-13B”, and “LLaMA-2-70B” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents the score on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  Four bars are displayed for each LLM category, representing different SFT conditions: “no SFT” (blue), “+ SFT on D₀” (yellow), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light red), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (dark red). For LLaMA-2-7B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 65, while the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 76. For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 72, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 78. For LLaMA-2-70B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 68, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 79. The bars are grouped by LLM, with each group showing the four SFT conditions side-by-side. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
